import math

nav = 837624223
cash = 143579673

holdings = {
    "1216": 802000, "2207": 80000, "2317": 99000, "2330": 10000,
    "2379": 31000, "2412": 422000, "2603": 85000, "2609": 367000,
    "2610": 1163000, "2618": 838000, "2880": 448000, "2886": 812000,
    "2891": 606000, "2892": 425000, "2912": 95000, "3045": 306000,
    "3227": 96000, "3293": 55000, "4749": 23000, "4904": 290000,
    "5871": 176000, "5876": 657000, "5880": 641000, "8415": 415000
}

decisions = [
    ("D1", "7828", "BUY", 0.035, 1295),
    ("D2", "8415", "ADD", 0.035, 39.85),
    ("D3", "2207", "ADD", 0.055, 516),
    ("D4", "3293", "ADD", 0.055, 754),
    ("D5", "2891", "TRIM", 0.016, 68),
    ("D6", "2609", "TRIM", 0.01, 53),
    ("D7", "4749", "SELL_ALL", 0.0, 590),
]

buy_amt = 0
sell_amt = 0
for d_id, ticker, action, tw, price in decisions:
    cur = holdings.get(ticker, 0)
    target = math.floor(tw * nav / price / 1000) * 1000
    diff = target - cur
    side = "BUY" if diff > 0 else "SELL"
    shares = abs(diff)
    amt = shares * price
    if side == "BUY":
        buy_amt += amt
    else:
        sell_amt += amt
        assert shares <= cur, f"Oversell {ticker}"
    print(f"{d_id} {ticker}: cur={cur}, target={target}, side={side}, shares={shares}, amt={amt:,.0f}")

est_cash = cash - buy_amt + sell_amt
est_cash_pct = est_cash / nav
print(f"Buy total: {buy_amt:,.0f}, Sell total: {sell_amt:,.0f}")
print(f"Est cash: {est_cash:,.0f}, Est cash pct: {est_cash_pct:.4f}")
